verdicts.reason: Both make the same mistakes. The pattern frame is left as an empty hole, and the headline 'WE LOVE YOU!' is pulled out of the frame and shrunk into a small, cramped text stack under it. The reading order is also jumbled: 'DEAR TEACHERS!' now sits below the headline and the school name, which breaks the original greeting → message → details flow. The only difference is placement: A pushes everything up and leaves about 130px of dead space at the bottom, while B centres the group a little better vertically, so B is slightly more balanced.
